title: Mr C Residences footer
description: A slim brick-red legal strip: small bold underlined links (call, email) at the left and legal links, a copyright and a site credit at the right, divided by thin vertical bars, in one 37px row on desktop and two stacked columns on phones. Each underline draws back to the right on hover and regrows from the left.
notes: a primary band with primary-foreground text
an item may have lead text before its link (e.g. 'Site by' + the studio's name), or be text only
